name: Home Ownership
overview: Scripture teaches that home ownership is a God-ordained blessing tied to His covenant promises and provision. The Lord grants His people the land to possess and dwell in, emphasizing that all wealth and blessings, including the power to acquire property, come from Him. While the earth belongs to the Lord and all who live within it, He entrusts individuals with stewardship over their homes and possessions, calling them to act justly and not steal. Thus, owning a home reflects both God's generosity and the believer’s responsibility to honor Him in their stewardship.
